findings.steps: Open a leave's editor window, type a Remark, drag the leave's bar on the month, then top-bar Undo.
findings.expected: once the record is back as it was when the window opened, nothing was changed behind it.
findings.saw: the notice stays, with "theirs" now equal to the value at opening. (Dragging a leave's bar always collides with a typed remark, because the move rewrites the "till" tail - by design?)

findings.title: Escape did not close the settings window after it closed the Calendar
findings.steps: Inputs > gear > "Calendar…" > press Escape three times.
findings.expected: Escape closes the front window each time (brief).
findings.saw: the Calendar closed on the first press; the Inputs settings window stayed after the others (read from the page, no picture).

findings.title: Observation: an extension re-states who placed the leave
findings.steps: X-06: Saber approves 5 Aug; Warden approves 6 Aug.
findings.expected: the plan's table row 5 (the builder's reading, told to the owner).
findings.saw: the bar and the day read "Placed by Warden for Ace"; Saber, who first approved it, is no longer named anywhere.

notWalked: X-02 phone: the bar drag was a MOUSE in a phone-sized screen, not a real finger sequence.

X-06 phone: Undo and reload of the MOVE not finished (script stopped on a covered date); the cut/Undo/reload was done on the phone. X-07 phone: SANS reads and Undo not done. X-08 phone: not walked (the nav is behind the menu there; the desktop result is the finding).

X-01 to X-05: a sign-out and sign-in at every checkpoint - reloads were done at each checkpoint; sign-out/in only where a second person was needed (X-04, X-09). Print and export of issued views (only View-only Sched read).
